rappel_detail.anchor: old fixed sling or tat left by earlier parties; inspect and back up
rappel_detail.station: The top of the 4th/low-5th-class chimney-and-ramp section below the North Peak summit.
rappel_detail.notes: First rappel, on a single 60 m rope.

rappel_detail.anchor: natural gear: cams or nuts in cracks, or slings on horns; fixed gear varies year to year
rappel_detail.station: Within the chimney-and-ramp section, at the end of the first rappel.
The lower part of the chimney-and-ramp section.
rappel_detail.notes: Third rappel, which some parties skip by downclimbing; it reaches easier 3rd-class ground above the glacier. Two ropes let parties link stations in fewer pulls.

set.rappels: 2-3 rappels on a single 60 m rope through the chimney-and-ramp section to easier ground
set.rappel_count_note: Parties describe two to three rappels through the chimney-and-ramp section, on a single 60 m rope. The first anchor is usually old fixed tat; expect to build natural anchors for the rest. Lengths are not published.
